asr.full_text: Understanding Spillover. Firstly spillover is never guaranteed and spillover happens when your sponsor places someone under you in the leg. Initially you were introduced into Miro Trading International by your sponsor in either their left or right leg. If you start seeing people added under you that you did not introduce this is spillover. If you would like to become binary qualified you will need to put someone in the Spillover side and in the other leg of your business yourself. You will also need $200 in your own trading pool. If you have questions or for more information, please contact Clint.
